Print and Format a Styled Table for HTML or LaTeX Output

print_kable.Rd

This function prints and formats a styled table in either HTML or LaTeX format using kableExtra.

print_kable(
  x,
  num_col = 1,
  rowname_label = NA,
  caption = NA,
  digits = 2,
  fontsize = 16,
  big.mark = ",",
  na_str = "",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  escape = TRUE,
  format.args = list(decimal.mark = ".", big.mark = ","),
  format,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

The matrix or data frame to be formatted as a table.

num_col

An integer specifying the number of columns to split the output table into (default: 1).

rowname_label

A character string specifying the column name for the row names; if not provided, the row names will not be printed (default: NA).

caption

A character string specifying the caption for the table (default: ”).

digits

An integer indicating the number of digits to display (default: 2).

fontsize

Font size for the table (default: 9).

big.mark

A character string used as the thousands separator for numbers (default: ',').

na_str

A string used to replace missing values (default: ”).

booktabs

Logical indicating whether to use the booktabs formatting (default: TRUE).

escape

Logical indicating whether to escape special characters in the table (default: TRUE).

format.args

A list of additional formatting arguments to customize number representation.

format

A character string specifying the output format: either "latex" or "html".

...

Additional arguments to be passed to the kbl function.

Value

A styled and formatted table in the specified format (LaTeX or HTML).

Examples

dt = mtcars[1:10, 1:3]
print_flextable(dt, num_col = 2, rowname_label = 'car',format='html')
